threads.body: [General] Dropping the entire `opentelemetry-samplers` dependency also removes the registered `linksbased_parentbased_always_on` sampler from Spring Boot starter applications, which is unrelated to the stated `RuleBasedRoutingSampler` migration. The 1.60.0 artifact supplies this through `LinksParentAlwaysOnSamplerProvider`, and the SDK incubator does not replace it. Please preserve that provider while removing only the deprecated rule-based functionality.

threads.body: [General] Removing the whole `opentelemetry-samplers` artifact also removes its `LinksParentAlwaysOnSamplerProvider`, so existing agent configurations with `otel.traces.sampler=linksbased_parentbased_always_on` will start failing even though this PR is scoped to `RuleBasedRoutingSampler`. The 1.60.0 artifact registers that provider through `ConfigurableSamplerProvider`, and the SDK incubator has no equivalent. Preserve this provider (for example by splitting/selectively bundling the contrib artifact) while excluding only the rule-based implementation.

Because this class now replaces the contrib implementation, regressions in its three compatibility-critical paths would go unnoticed; add tests covering delegation when there are no links, sampling when any link is sampled, and dropping when all links are unsampled.

threads.body: [General] This recursion only follows `parent_based`, but the SDK's declarative model also accepts a nested sampler at `always_record.root`, and the contrib sampler explicitly supports `rule_based_routing` anywhere a sampler is accepted. A valid `always_record: { root: { rule_based_routing: ... } }` configuration therefore creates the deprecated sampler without the promised warning. Please traverse `getAlwaysRecord().getRoot()` as well and add this case to the test.

replies.body:
No code change.

This branch uses OpenTelemetry SDK 1.66.0, whose declarative model and sampler factory do not support always_record. This configuration cannot be selected until a future SDK dependency update.

threads.body: [General] The links-based sampler is still selected and warned about under `otel.instrumentation.common.v3-preview`. Because this name is planned to become unrecognized when the bundled dependency is removed in 3.0, preview mode should mirror that behavior instead of accepting it; follow the existing Zipkin-removal pattern by throwing a configuration error in preview mode and warning only outside it.

V3 preview is intended to reproduce 3.0 behavior, and the adjacent Zipkin-removal customizer rejects configuration for dependencies scheduled to be dropped in 3.0. Since `rule_based_routing` is also slated to disappear in 3.0, reject it under `DeclarativeConfigV3Preview.isEnabled(model)` (without warning) and cover that mode.

+## Bundled sampler deprecations
+
+The Java agent and Spring Boot starter still bundle `io.opentelemetry.contrib:opentelemetry-samplers`.
+The following sampler names supplied by that dependency are deprecated in these distributions:
+
+- `rule_based_routing` in declarative configuration.
+- `linksbased_parentbased_always_on` with `otel.traces.sampler` or `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER`.
+
+Both names continue to work without configuration changes, but selecting either one logs a
+deprecation warning at startup. We plan to stop bundling the dependency and supporting these names
+in 3.0. This does not deprecate the contrib library itself.

+evaluate alternatives based on your sampling requirements.
